in_marathi.name: Mauli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Marriage and Children
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mauli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mauli is a name derived from the Sanskrit language and is commonly used in Hindu culture. This name signifies the goddess Parvati, who is the consort of Lord Shiva and the goddess of marriages, fertility, and children.
